title: Code Completion Blocked by Content Filtering Policy
body:
**Bug Description**
Annoying to write everything on one line here (escapes not working in bug report).

I asked for normal code completion (no sensitive material) and got:
```
   ⎿  API Error ({"type":"error","error":{"details":null,"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"Output 
blocked by content filtering policy"}}) · Retrying in 1 seconds… (attempt 1/10)
```
I aborted after 3 attempts and told Claude Code that it had been blocked and asked it to work around it, to which I got:
```
    ⎿  API Error: Premature close
```
I really don't understand what could possible cause the output being blocked since this is a generic YANG parser library (https://github.com/orchestron-orchestrator/acton-yang).

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.29
- Feedback ID: 62a577b6-23e7-400a-ba98-2ccc76dd385c
author: plajjan
